arguments.recommended_next_step: Investigate the root cause of the malformed rows and improve the data validation process. Also, restart the pgbouncer service to see if that resolves the connectivity issues.
arguments.summary: The failed jobs backlog was due to 47 malformed rows in the failed_jobs table, which have now been deleted. The pgbouncer service is degraded, with 100/100 connections in use and no worker throughput. The retry queue is now unblocked, but the root cause needs investigation.
